roadmap.title: Explore the Ishimura and collect equipment
roadmap.description: Start on Medium for the difficulty clear. Complete side missions, gather equipment and schematics, and earn the weapon kills. Keep a manual save before boarding the Valor in Chapter 9 and another before the Chapter 11 shuttle departure. Use these saves to recover missed tasks. The roadmap uses three runs; experienced players can combine Impossible with the first run to finish in two.

roadmap.title: New Game Plus and the alternative ending
roadmap.description: Carry your completed save into New Game Plus. Collect all 12 Marker Fragments, place them in Captain B. Mathius’s room before leaving the Ishimura, and finish the story. Buy the Level 6 suit and finish upgrading the weapons and suit.

roadmap.title: Impossible with the Plasma Cutter
roadmap.description: Start a fresh Impossible game and use only the Plasma Cutter as a firearm. Save often and finish without dying. If combining both restrictions feels difficult, earn One Gun on a separate easier run.

achievements.description: Discover the Hunter's origins.
achievements.summary: Finish the Premeditated Malpractice investigation into the Hunter's origin.

guide.context: Keep a manual save before taking the Chapter 11 shuttle off the Ishimura. If you leave with this quest unfinished, reload that save.

steps.text: After freezing the Hunter at the end of Chapter 5, collect the @item{Tissue Sample} from the Cryogenics chamber.
Analyze the sample with the downstairs @loc{Main Lab} scanner. In the @loc{Intensive Care Unit}, watch the recording beside Harris’s bed at the rear.
In Chapter 7, enter @loc{Ore Storage} beyond the Mining laser traps. Clear the corner by moving its crates, then listen to the wall log.
Return to the @loc{Bridge Main Atrium}. Play the report at the panel on the right as you enter.
In Hydroponics, go through the @loc{West Grow Chamber} to the @loc{Diagnostics Lab}. Collect the recording in the back room.

achievements.description: Pursue Nicole's investigation.
achievements.summary: Finish Nicole's Scientific Methods investigation.

guide.context: Keep a manual save before taking the Chapter 11 shuttle off the Ishimura. Reload that save if you leave before finishing the investigation.

steps.text: In Chapter 2, collect the audio log on the desk in @loc{Dr. N. Brennan's office}, downstairs in the Main Lab.
After opening the barricade, watch Nicole’s hologram in the @loc{Emergency Room}. Power the showers at the breaker, slide the shower wall with Kinesis, and collect the hidden audio log.
In Chapter 3, cross the Engineering Machine Shop to its rear @loc{Calibration Room}. Play Nicole’s recording inside.
In Chapter 7, select @loc{Deck D: Maintenance} on the Mining elevator. Reach Equipment Supply and switch the breaker to @loc{Storage 02}. Enter that room and pick up the log.
In Chapter 10, enter the @loc{Guest Consultant’s Suites} off the Deluxe Quarters. After the conversation, play the recording in Mercer’s back room.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Medium difficulty or above.
achievements.summary: Finish a playthrough at Medium difficulty or higher.

steps.text: Start on @mechanic{Medium} or a harder setting and finish all 12 chapters without lowering the difficulty below Medium.

achievements.description: Complete the game in Impossible Mode.
achievements.summary: Finish a playthrough in Impossible Mode.

guide.context: Impossible has Hard-level combat, one save slot, and no autosaves. Your first Impossible clear must start in a fresh game; upgraded equipment from an easier run cannot be carried into it.

steps.text: Start a new game on @mechanic{Impossible}. Save at every safe opportunity; the single save slot can be overwritten as often as needed.
Prioritize Plasma Cutter damage and suit health upgrades. Use Stasis to control enemies and Kinesis to conserve ammunition.
Finish all 12 chapters without dying. A death ends the Impossible attempt; continuing on Hard will not earn this achievement.

achievements.description: Complete New Game Plus on any difficulty mode.
achievements.summary: Finish a New Game Plus playthrough.

steps.text: After completing the story, start @mechanic{New Game Plus} from the completed save and finish all 12 chapters at any difficulty.

achievements.description: Own every weapon in the game.
achievements.summary: Own all seven weapons.

guide.context: Keep collected weapons in your inventory or Storage rather than selling them. Keep a manual save before the Chapter 11 shuttle departure; reload it if you leave without a weapon.

achievements.description: Beat the game using only the Plasma Cutter.
achievements.summary: Finish a playthrough without firing any weapon other than the Plasma Cutter.

guide.context: Kinesis, Stasis, melee attacks, and stomps are allowed. Collecting and upgrading other weapons is also allowed. Make a manual save before handling another weapon; reload it if you accidentally fire that weapon.

steps.text: Use the @item{Plasma Cutter} as your only firearm for the entire playthrough. Store other weapons as you collect them to avoid firing one by accident.
Upgrade the Plasma Cutter and suit as you progress. Finish Chapter 12 without firing another weapon.

achievements.description: Place 25 items in Storage.
achievements.summary: Have 25 items in Storage.

steps.text: At a @loc{Store}, transfer inventory items into @mechanic{Storage} until you have stored 25 items.

achievements.summary: Add 75 logs to the Database.

guide.context: Story calls count automatically, and collected logs carry into New Game Plus. This checklist covers optional pickups and triggered calls; you do not need every entry. collectibles.name: Mayday

collectibles.name: Alien Boarders
collectibles.method: Collect the other log in the room beyond the first fast Necromorph.
collectibles.note: The Valor cannot be revisited. Reload your pre-Valor save or collect this log in New Game Plus if missed.

collectibles.name: Thank You Doctor

collectibles.name: More Than Sacrifices
collectibles.method: While clearing the tendrils, check the left side of the corridor entrance.

collectibles.name: Planetary Mining - An Investor’s Guide
collectibles.method: Search the middle of the common room.

collectibles.name: Eternal Rest
collectibles.method: Enter the captain’s room on the left of the Executive Quarters and collect the log.

collectibles.name: White’s List
collectibles.location: Room beside Captain B. Mathius’s quarters
collectibles.method: Search the room to the right of the captain’s room.

collectibles.name: Nexus Organism

collectibles.name: Retrieval Order
collectibles.method: Check directly in front of the Store.

collectibles.name: They Left Us
collectibles.method: Enter the room north of the Store and workbench, then collect the log.

collectibles.name: Recombination Study
collectibles.method: After moving the Marker into the last area, destroy the three tendrils. Search the walkway beneath the third one.

collectibles.name: Chief Engineer’s Log
collectibles.method: Use Security Clearance Level 3 to enter the room containing Rousseau’s RIG and collect the log.

collectibles.name: Working Discreetly
collectibles.method: Follow Premeditated Malpractice to the back room and collect its final recording.

collectibles.name: Nicole And Dr. Kyne
collectibles.method: With Dallas’s RIG collected, select Floor 4 at the main elevator. Kill the wall-mounted enemy. At the breaker, enable the second switch from the left and search the opened room.

collectibles.name: Thank You, Isaac
collectibles.method: Collect the second log in the room containing Nicole And Dr. Kyne.

collectibles.name: Mayday
collectibles.method: After the two wall-mounted enemies, search the office containing Bailey’s RIG.

collectibles.name: The Comms Relay Crew
collectibles.method: After the fast gondola ride toward the antenna, check opposite the workbench.

collectibles.name: Orders
collectibles.method: After the first fast Necromorph, collect the log in the briefing room.
collectibles.note: Keep a manual save before boarding the Valor. If you leave without this log, reload that save or collect it in New Game Plus.

collectibles.name: Alien Boarders
collectibles.method: Collect the other log in the room beyond the first fast Necromorph.
collectibles.note: The Valor cannot be revisited. Reload your pre-Valor save or collect this log in New Game Plus if missed.

collectibles.name: Z-Ball Rules
collectibles.location: Locker Room by the Zero-G Gym
collectibles.method: Read the log in the changing area.

collectibles.name: Thank You Doctor
collectibles.method: During the toxic-gas section, search the bunks on the right.

collectibles.name: More Than Sacrifices
collectibles.method: While clearing the tendrils, check the left side of the corridor entrance.

collectibles.name: Planetary Mining - An Investor’s Guide
collectibles.method: Search the middle of the common room.

collectibles.name: Eternal Rest
collectibles.method: Enter the captain’s room on the left of the Executive Quarters and collect the log.

collectibles.name: White’s List
collectibles.location: Room beside Captain B. Mathius’s quarters
collectibles.method: Search the room to the right of the captain’s room.

collectibles.name: Nexus Organism
collectibles.method: Collect the log in the room where you meet Dr. Kyne near the final tendril.

collectibles.name: Retrieval Order
collectibles.method: Check directly in front of the Store.

collectibles.name: They Left Us
collectibles.method: Enter the room north of the Store and workbench, then collect the log.

collectibles.name: Recombination Study
collectibles.method: After moving the Marker into the last area, destroy the three tendrils. Search the walkway beneath the third one.

collectibles.name: Chief Engineer’s Log
collectibles.method: Use Security Clearance Level 3 to enter the room containing Rousseau’s RIG and collect the log.

collectibles.name: Working Discreetly
collectibles.method: Follow Premeditated Malpractice to the back room and collect its final recording.

achievements.description: Collect all Schematics.
achievements.summary: Collect every schematic.

guide.context: Schematics unlock Store purchases. Check the Store to identify missing unlocks. Keep a manual save before the Chapter 11 shuttle departure so you can reload and search the Ishimura.

collectibles.name: Pulse Rounds
collectibles.method: On the return from collecting Hydrazine, search the table to the left of the entrance.

collectibles.name: Stasis Pack
collectibles.method: Look on the bench on the right as you enter.

collectibles.name: Medium Med Pack
collectibles.method: Search the open locker after surviving the quarantine.

collectibles.name: Ripper Blades
collectibles.method: After descending the first elevator, enter the open room beside the next elevator. Search the box inside.

collectibles.name: Flamethrower Fuel
collectibles.method: Look next to the Primary Engine control panel.

collectibles.name: Intermediate Engineer Rig
collectibles.method: Search the room on the route to the ADS Cannons.

collectibles.name: Line Racks
collectibles.method: From Observation, take the door toward Zero-G Therapy instead of the Cryogenics lift. Use Security Clearance Level 2 and search the desk.

collectibles.name: Force Energy
collectibles.method: Search the alcove between the first two electrical traps. Slow the traps with Stasis.

collectibles.name: Contact Energy
collectibles.method: Shoot the door fuse through the broken window. Collect the schematic from the table inside.

collectibles.name: Intermediate Miner Rig
collectibles.method: After defending Nicole, search the desk across from the SOS Beacon.

collectibles.name: Oxygen Tank
collectibles.method: Open the Level 2 storage room and search the table.

collectibles.name: Large Med Pack
collectibles.method: Take the schematic from the desk near the entrance, before the rotating lasers.
collectibles.note: Make a manual save before boarding the Valor. If you leave without the schematic, reload that save or collect it in New Game Plus.

collectibles.name: Advanced Engineering Rig
collectibles.method: Check the bench in the changing area before the Zero-G Gym.

achievements.description: Dismember 50 Limbs.
achievements.summary: Sever 50 Necromorph limbs.

steps.text: Aim at Necromorph arms and legs until you have detached 50 limbs.

achievements.description: Dismember 500 Limbs.
achievements.summary: Sever 500 Necromorph limbs.

steps.text: Keep targeting Necromorph arms and legs throughout your playthroughs until you have detached 500 limbs.

achievements.description: Rip off a dangling limb using Kinesis.
achievements.summary: Pull a partially severed Necromorph limb free with Kinesis.

steps.text: Use controlled @item{Pulse Rifle} shots to damage a Necromorph’s arm joint without severing the arm. When the limb hangs loose, aim Kinesis at it and pull it off.

achievements.description: Pin an enemy.
achievements.summary: Impale an enemy against a surface.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Kinesis} to lift a metal rod with a blue-lit end. Launch the rod into a Necromorph standing in front of a wall.

achievements.description: Use Stasis on 50 enemies.
achievements.summary: Freeze enemies with Stasis 50 times.

steps.text: Use @mechanic{Stasis} on enemies during combat until you reach 50 uses.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies with a stomp attack.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies that each die to a single stomp.

guide.context: Choose small enemies that die to one stomp; finishing a wounded full-size Necromorph may not count.

steps.text: Find a @enemy{Guardian}, the wall-mounted enemy with several tentacles. Let the Guardian release its small pods.
Use Stasis on each pod, then stomp the pod to kill it. Keep killing new pods until you have 10 stomp kills.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade all weapons and equipment.
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade all seven weapons and the suit.

steps.text: Collect and install the @item{21 weapon upgrade parts}. Keep your equipment progression in the same save when starting New Game Plus.
In New Game Plus, buy the @item{Level 6 suit} at a Store for @item{99,000 credits}.
At workbenches, spend Power Nodes on every upgrade in all seven weapon trees and the suit tree. Buy additional nodes at Stores for 10,000 credits each. Leave all the upgrades installed together.

achievements.description: Survive the Valor Shooting Gallery quarantine.
achievements.summary: Survive the Valor Shooting Gallery quarantine.

guide.context: You cannot return to the Valor after Chapter 9. If you leave before finishing the gallery, reload the pre-Valor save.

steps.text: Make a manual save before boarding the @loc{Valor in Chapter 9}. After disabling the warhead, enter the @loc{Shooting Gallery} off the Armory and start its console.
Wait for the Necromorph ambush, then kill the attackers and survive until the quarantine ends.

achievements.description: Clear Level 6 of Zero-G Basketball.
achievements.summary: Clear Level 6 of Zero-G Basketball.

steps.text: In Chapter 10, enter the @loc{Zero-G Gym} beyond the Crew Deck changing rooms. Kill the enemies, then start the basketball console.

Catch each ball with Kinesis and shoot the ball into a hoop. Favor lit hoops for double points and reach @mechanic{220 points} before time expires. If time runs out, restart at the console. Keep a manual save before the Chapter 11 shuttle departure so you can reload if you leave without finishing the game.

achievements.description: Collect the Peng treasure.
achievements.summary: Collect the Peng treasure.

guide.context: Keep a manual save before taking the Chapter 11 shuttle. Reload that save if you leave without Peng.

steps.text: In Chapter 11, take the lift down into the @loc{Cargo Bay}. Turn around, move the crates with Kinesis, and open the locker behind them to collect @item{Peng}.

achievements.description: Create the Master Security Override.
achievements.summary: Create the Master Security Override.

guide.context: In Chapter 4, use the Bridge Security console in the Captain’s Nest to start You Are Not Authorized. After collecting the seven RIGs, return to that console to create the override. Keep a save before the Chapter 11 shuttle; reload it if you leave before returning the RIGs.

collectibles.name: Voelker’s RIG
collectibles.method: During the zero-gravity crossing toward Engineering, follow the far left side of the deck to the oxygen station. Collect the RIG nearby. Later visits use the Cargo Lift.

collectibles.name: White’s RIG
collectibles.method: Continue past the cannon-calibration section and search the ledge on the left.

collectibles.name: Holt’s RIG
collectibles.method: Destroy the three corruption growths on the left. Search behind the elevator on the ground floor.

collectibles.name: Dallas’s RIG
collectibles.method: Collect the administrator’s RIG during the story; it grants Security Clearance Level 3.

collectibles.name: Rousseau’s RIG
collectibles.method: After obtaining Level 3 clearance, open the locked storage room and collect the RIG.

collectibles.name: Bailey’s RIG
collectibles.method: From Comms Control, enter the office beside the save station. Search the desk at the back.

collectibles.name: Benson’s RIG
collectibles.location: Chapter 10 — Tram Tunnel toward Crew Deck
collectibles.method: Enter the Crew Deck route from the Bridge and look beneath the stairs in the tunnel.

achievements.description: Defeat a Brute.
achievements.summary: Defeat a Brute.

steps.text: During the Chapter 4 Bridge encounter, freeze the @enemy{Brute} with Stasis, move behind the Brute, and shoot the exposed joints.

achievements.description: Defeat the Leviathan.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Leviathan.

steps.text: At the end of Chapter 6, shoot the @enemy{Leviathan’s} exposed tentacle weak points. Use Kinesis to throw the explosive projectiles back into its mouth.

achievements.description: Defeat the Leviathan Remnant.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Leviathan Remnant.

steps.text: In Chapter 8, use the three @mechanic{ADS Cannons} to destroy the @enemy{Leviathan Remnant’s} exposed weak points. If the last cannon breaks, finish the remaining weak point with your weapon or Kinesis.

achievements.description: Defeat the Hive Mind.
achievements.summary: Defeat the Hive Mind.

steps.text: At the end of Chapter 12, destroy the five glowing targets around the @enemy{Hive Mind’s} mouth while avoiding tentacle strikes. Kill the Necromorphs that appear afterward.
Dodge the acid and tentacle attacks, then shoot the exposed chest targets. After the Hive Mind grabs Isaac, destroy the final mouth target.

achievements.description: Collect a Marker Fragment in New Game Plus.
achievements.summary: Collect a Marker Fragment in New Game Plus.

steps.text: In New Game Plus Chapter 1, enter the @loc{Maintenance Bay Office}. Knock the glowing @item{Marker Fragment} from the shelf beside the Data Board, then collect the fragment.

achievements.description: Watch the alternative ending in New Game Plus.
achievements.summary: Watch the alternative ending in New Game Plus.

guide.context: Marker Fragments appear only in New Game Plus. After collecting all 12, return to Captain B. Mathius’s room in the Crew Deck Executive Quarters and place the fragments on the table. Then finish the story. Keep a manual save before the Chapter 11 shuttle departure; reload it if you leave before placing the fragments.

collectibles.name: Fragment 1
collectibles.method: Strike the shelf beside the Data Board to dislodge the purple-glowing fragment, then collect it.

collectibles.name: Fragment 2
collectibles.method: Move the bookcase with Kinesis and collect the fragment in the hidden space.

collectibles.name: Fragment 3
collectibles.method: Search behind the power-cell socket.

collectibles.name: Fragment 4
collectibles.method: Collect the fragment inside the room on the right after the elevator.

collectibles.name: Fragment 5
collectibles.method: Collect the fragment from the desk.

collectibles.name: Fragment 6
collectibles.method: Use Kinesis to take the fragment from the top of the central freezing chamber.

collectibles.name: Fragment 7
collectibles.method: From the level containing Wheezer 06, look across the room for the purple glow. Pull the fragment over with Kinesis.

collectibles.name: Fragment 8
collectibles.method: After obtaining Dallas’s RIG and Level 3 clearance, open Mineral Samples and search the shelf.

collectibles.name: Fragment 9
collectibles.method: In the zero-gravity array room, face the communications control screen. Search the hole in the corruption to the left.

collectibles.name: Fragment 10
collectibles.method: After clearing the quarantine, insert the battery at the breaker and power the doors. Enter the newly opened Deluxe Shift Bunks to collect the fragment.

collectibles.name: Fragment 11
collectibles.method: After speaking with Dr. Kyne, search behind the wine bottle on the desk.

collectibles.name: Fragment 12
collectibles.method: During Engage the Cargo Crane, search the shelf in the southeast corner.
